hooks.command: printf '%s\tSessionStart\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> experiments/.hook_log 2>/dev/null; [ -f scripts/session_brief.py ] || exit 0; uv run python -m scripts.session_brief 2>/dev/null; exit 0
printf '%s\tPreToolUse\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> experiments/.hook_log 2>/dev/null; [ -f scripts/submit_gate.py ] || exit 0; uv run python -m scripts.submit_gate

printf '%s\tPostToolUse\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> experiments/.hook_log 2>/dev/null; [ -f scripts/viz_guard.py ] || exit 0; f=experiments/log.csv; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; m=$(stat -f %m "$f" 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y "$f" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$m" ] || exit 0; [ $(( $(date +%s) - m )) -lt 20 ] && uv run python -m scripts.viz_guard 2>/dev/null; exit 0
printf '%s\tStop\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> experiments/.hook_log 2>/dev/null; [ -f scripts/session_audit.py ] || exit 0; uv run python -m scripts.session_audit 2>/dev/null; exit 0
printf '%s\tPreCompact\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> experiments/.hook_log 2>/dev/null; [ -f scripts/session_snapshot.py ] || exit 0; uv run python -m scripts.session_snapshot 2>/dev/null; exit 0

printf '%s\tPostCompact\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> experiments/.hook_log 2>/dev/null; [ -f scripts/session_brief.py ] || exit 0; uv run python -m scripts.session_brief --event PostCompact 2>/dev/null; exit 0
